sql:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND refund_cents > 0 AND refund_cents < paid_cents THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS partial_refund_order_count
FROM "data"."main"."order_fact" order_model_src_10000
WHERE DATE_TRUNC('day', ordered_at) BETWEEN '2026-06-01' AND '2026-06-30'
